title: Accountable Neural Aggregation in Computational Pathology: From Paired-Acquisition Representations to Whole-Slide and Institutional Learning
description: A program-level foundations preprint spanning representation formation, whole-slide aggregation, and institutional aggregation in computational pathology. It covers Paired-Acquisition Neural Factorization, TransnnMIL, PathologyFL, FAIR-WEIGHTS-H, benchmark studies, and claim-bound provenance. Architecture, empirical evidence, pending validation, negative results, and prohibited interpretations are separated explicitly. The manuscript does not claim clinical utility, deployment readiness, complete scanner invariance, or validated superiority for research lines whose controlled evaluations remain pending.
